name: panfolio
description: Read Panfolio recipes and kitchen techniques with original quantities, explanations and sources.

interface.longDescription: Read Panfolio recipes and kitchen techniques with original quantities, explanations and sources. Uses public GitHub Markdown or an already connected Panfolio MCP, with no terminal, Python, app login or API key. Requires one of those reading capabilities in the host; this package does not connect MCP automatically. Does not access private app data.
